ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple light-colored, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark central region and anatomical right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and significant linear scarring across the central and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular spot is located in the lower third of the white field on the anatomical right lobe.
